instruction: Keep going to the previous song on Spotify until you reach a song by Luna Starlight.

steps.code:
passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_password = next(p["password"] for p in passwords if p["account_name"] == "spotify")
login_result = apis.spotify.login(username='mir-powe@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
spotify_access_token = login_result["access_token"]
print(login_result)

target_found = False
start_song_id = current_song.get("song_id")
for i in range(100):
    artists = [a.get("name", "") for a in current_song.get("artists", [])]
    if "Luna Starlight" in artists:
        target_found = True
        break
    prev_result = apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=spotify_access_token)
    current_song = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=spotify_access_token)
    if current_song.get("song_id") == start_song_id and i > 0:
        # Full cycle without finding the target
        break

print("Found:", target_found)
print(current_song)
